focus.name: scene-transition-graphics-extents
focus.purpose: Bound the transition tile tables and palette sources selected by the terminal and scene-transition render services.

evidence: SceneResource_RenderTransitionTileBand uses VDP_ANIMATION_FRAME_OFFSET, wraps after 0x20, and copies 16 words.
Level_RenderTerminalTransitionTileBand wraps after 0x1C and copies 14 words.
Render_RunPaletteTransitionFrom consumes four 16-word bands from the direct 0x00129BD2 source.
Render_UploadPaletteBand0 copies exactly 16 words from the direct 0x00129C8A source.
The four ranges are adjacent from 0x00129B92 through 0x00129CA9 and end immediately before SCENE_INITIAL_C000_PALETTE_DATA.
limitations: The semantic color roles of individual palette words remain represented by their verified consumer service.
The separate initial C000/palette block at 0x00129CAA is not claimed by this slice.
